scene: You climb onto an airy wooden catwalk above Spice Bridge.
picture: Flat side view. Along a wooden plank catwalk, the player in her lilac headscarf and mustard coat stands near the left. At the far left stands a brass telescope on a tripod. In the centre, a curled sleeping monkey rests on a red blanket. At the right, a rope suspension bridge stretches off-screen.
shown: a mounted brass telescope on a tripod pointing outward at the far left
a small furry monkey curled up asleep on a blanket in the centre
a creaky swaying suspension bridge spanning toward another tower on the right

variants.scene: The evening breeze cools your cheeks high above the busy market docks.
You reach the wooden walkway, still searching for clues about {quest}.
Warm lanterns glow as gentle harbour waves lap the timbers below your feet.
